strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout via cartTotal(items, { coupon }) in src/cart.js: 10% bulk discount at 10+ items in total, SAVE5 coupon taking $5 off after the bulk discount (floored at $0), unknown coupons refused, and free shipping when discounted goods reach $50 (else $4.99; empty cart costs 0). Unit tests on cartTotal must prove each rule and its boundaries. Reading the code shows two likely defects: the bulk discount uses `> 10` (exactly 10 items get no discount), and coupon lookup uses `in`, so inherited keys like "constructor" are accepted instead of refused.
inScope: cartTotal pricing: bulk discount, SAVE5 coupon, coupon refusal, shipping rules, empty cart
Boundaries: 9/10 items, $49.99/$50 goods, coupon larger than goods
outOfScope: UI or API checkout flows (none exist in this repo)
assumptions: cartTotal is the checkout pricing entry point; amounts are dollars rounded to cents
Refusal of a coupon is a thrown Error; tests check it throws and that the message names the submitted code, not the full wording
Tests whose assertions show a defect are kept and marked it.fails with a comment, and the defect recorded
openQuestions: Should coupon codes be case-sensitive (is 'save5' refused)? The code refuses it; the ticket doesn't say. Not tested.

risks.description: Off-by-one at the 10-item bulk threshold (code uses > instead of >=)
risks.mitigation: TC1 tests exactly 10 items; TC2 tests 9

risks.description: Coupon applied before bulk discount, or shipping judged before discounts
risks.mitigation: TC4 and TC9 pick amounts where the order changes the total

risks.description: Inherited object keys accepted as coupons, yielding NaN totals

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (summing line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, goods never below $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error
Shipping is free when goods cost $50 or more after discounts, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs 0

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied to a cart of exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1: carts with 10 or more items get 10% off. src/cart.js bulkDiscount uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items get no discount. Expected 31.99 for 10 x $3; actual 34.99.
defects.evidence: src/cart.js:22 `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`; TC1 marked it.fails and passes (assertion fails) in run attempt 0.

defects.title: Coupon codes matching inherited object keys (e.g. 'constructor') are accepted, giving NaN total
defects.description: AC2: any coupon code other than SAVE5 is refused with an error. src/cart.js checks `coupon in COUPONS`, which is true for prototype keys like 'constructor' or 'toString'; no error is thrown and the subtraction of a function yields a NaN total.
defects.evidence: src/cart.js:30 `!(coupon in COUPONS)`; TC7 marked it.fails and passes (no error thrown) in run attempt 0.
